name: Dynamite AI

sources.title: Homepage — live AI tools directory (self-reported DR 31), categories with live counts, 'Submit tool' nav
Submit page — 3-step wizard (tool details / choose plan / get listed); 'Free to list — or fast-track the review down to 24 hours'

requirements: AI-powered tool; categories include Productivity, SaaS, Dev Tools, Marketing, Chatbot, Generative Art, Video/Image generators, Finance, Education
Listing includes a permanent tool page with a dofollow link and a spot on the category page
Free listing is the default; a paid fast-track shortens review to ~24h (featured spots sold separately via Gumroad)
preparation: Tool name, email, website URL, description, a representative image, category, and pricing model (free/freemium/paid)
Optional: their embeddable badge (created via /badge after submitting)
workflow: Step 1: fill Tool Name, Email, Website, Description, Image, Category, Pricing
Step 2: choose the free plan or the paid fast-track
Step 3: submit and wait for review — free queue duration unstated, fast-track is ~24h
After listing, optionally generate a custom badge at /badge
watchFor: Free-tier review turnaround is unstated — only the paid 24h fast-track is promised
DR 31 is a self-reported Ahrefs badge — modest SEO value
Featured 'this week' slots are a separate Gumroad purchase, not part of the submit flow
Directory is small (hundreds of tools); expect niche exposure
countsAsLive: The tool has a public /tools/<slug> page on dynamite-ai.com linked from its category page
unknowns: Fast-track price (plan step not rendered without input)
Whether listings can be edited after publication
